title: Devin AI: is the first AI software engineer worth the hype?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Devin AI just wrote a full app by itself — and it's going viral.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This could change how companies hire and build software forever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Devin is an AI that writes, tests, and debugs code like a human engineer.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses a new type of reasoning called "code synthesis" to build apps from scratch.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Startups and dev teams can now ship products faster than ever before.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Devin isn’t just a tool — it’s a new kind of co-worker.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you tried Devin AI yet? Let me know in the comments.
